ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: A Deep Dive into Minnesota's Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the Minnesota child care fraud scandal, including the alleged theft of $250 million and the impact on national child care funding
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the system that allowed the alleged fraud to occur
questions: How did the alleged fraud occur?
What is the impact on national child care funding?
ideas.insight: The Minnesota child care fraud scandal has significant implications for national child care funding and policy. A deep dive into the scandal could uncover a larger pattern of corruption and abuse.
